output.summary: A small evergreen citrus hybrid of uncertain origin, possibly arising in northeastern India during the first millennium BC. It produces pointed oval yellow fruit with aromatic rind and notably sour juice; the juice, pulp and rind are widely used in foods and drinks.
output.edibilityNote: The juice, pulp and rind are used in cooking, baking and drinks; whole lemons are also made into preserves and liqueurs.
